findings.claim: Ciena 直接雲端業者（hyperscaler 直銷）營收占公司總營收比重從 FY2025 Q4 的 42% 上升至 FY2026 Q3（財報日 2026-09-03）的 53%，Q3 直接雲端客戶營收年增 82%——代表銷售組合正從傳統電信商間接／系統整合通路結構性轉向 hyperscaler 直銷。
findings.source: Fierce Network, 'Ciena reports Q2 2026 revenue of $1.57B, up 40% YoY' (https://www.fierce-network.com/broadband/ciena-reports-q2-2026-revenue-157b-40-yoy); Simply Wall St News, 'The Bull Case For Ciena (CIEN) Could Change Following Cloud AI-Driven Optical Demand Surge' (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/tech/nyse-cien/ciena/news/the-bull-case-for-ciena-cien-could-change-following-cloud-ai)

findings.claim: Ciena 對 hyperscaler 客戶採多種銷售/交付模式並行：完整系統（complete systems）、可插拔相干模組（coherent pluggables，如 800ZR）、以及客製化零組件/模組（供 hyperscaler 自行整合進其自建平台）——與過去以完整系統銷售為主的模式不同。
findings.source: Seeking Alpha, 'Ciena Corporation: AI Hyperscalers Demand For Hyper-Rails To Drive Market Momentum' (https://seekingalpha.com/article/4934149-ciena-corporation-ai-hyperscalers-demand-for-hyper-rails-to-drive-market-momentum)

findings.claim: Ciena 過去在間接通路端曾建立正式合作夥伴分級體系「Ciena Partner Network」（2018-11-15 發布，取代 one-size-fits-all 的舊合作夥伴計畫），作為現行 hyperscaler 直銷佔比快速上升前的通路基礎背景——顯示公司通路結構本身經歷過至少兩次轉型（間接分銷分級化 → 現行 hyperscaler 直銷化）。
findings.source: Ciena newsroom, 'Ciena Launches Groundbreaking Ciena Partner Network' (https://www.ciena.com/about/newsroom/press-releases/Ciena-Launches-Groundbreaking-Ciena-Partner-Network.html); BusinessWire mirror (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20181115005102/en/Ciena-Launches-Groundbreaking-Ciena-Partner-Network)

findings.claim: Ciena 2026-09-03 公布 FY2026 Q3 財報：non-GAAP EPS $2.11（共識預估 $1.72）、營收 $1.67B（共識 $1.63B，年增 37%），雙雙優於預期；但公司對 Q4 FY2026 指引營收約 $1.75B、毛利率約 45%（隱含季環比小幅下滑），加上 AI 網通類股資金輪動，股價當日盤中一度重挫約 9.5%，收盤跌幅約 13.7%（不同來源數字略有差異）。
findings.source: The Motley Fool, 'Why Ciena Stock Just Crashed' (https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/09/03/why-ciena-stock-just-crashed/); Seeking Alpha, 'Ciena slides 10% amid AI-networking rotation despite record quarter' (https://seekingalpha.com/news/4640170-ciena-slides-10-percent-amid-ai-networking-rotation-despite-record-quarter)

findings.claim: 隨 Q3 FY2026 財報，Ciena 將 FY2026 全年營收指引由原先 $6.2B–$6.4B 上修至 $6.37B–$6.47B（隱含中值年增約 32%以上），為財報後上調的正面訊號，但市場對指引隱含的 Q4 毛利率下滑仍有疑慮。
findings.source: The Motley Fool, 'Why Ciena Stock Just Crashed' (https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/09/03/why-ciena-stock-just-crashed/); StockTitan, 'Ciena Reports Fiscal Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results' (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CIEN/ciena-reports-fiscal-third-quarter-2026-financial-i9rqcwx46luc.html)
